setup.Evans_class: e_j in Q_joint in each C4 chart j

lift_fiber.shape: if inhabited, Lift(e_j) is a K-torsor: every two lifts differ by a unique element of K
lift_fiber.meaning: the two polarized quotients determine the pair state only modulo the common radical

C4_transport.cocycle: the four c_j form a radical-valued cyclic 1-cocycle; changing lifts x_j by k_j in K_j changes c_j by the corresponding coboundary
C4_transport.obstruction: a coherent C4 lift exists iff the cocycle class [c] vanishes, with the fourfold equation twisted by the declared Tate/metaplectic phase

coherencer.base: two polarized quotient observations agree on the Evans class
coherencer.two_seams: the selected lifts into the plus and minus pair presentations
coherencer.higher_cell: a choice of radical correction k_j trivializing c_j around the C4 cycle
coherencer.categorical_name: equivariant descent/lifting coherencer for a torsor over the intersection radical

positive_apex.descent_requirement: the one-leg pair energy must annihilate K or be constant on each lift torsor before it defines an energy on Q_joint
positive_apex.if_not: a choice of lift changes the energy, so positivity at the apex is not quotient-invariant
positive_apex.strict_gate: after radical descent and coherent lift, the state must have nonzero quotient energy

testable_finite_form.matrices: given finite q_+,q_-,F, compute K=ker stack(q_+,q_-)
testable_finite_form.residual: compute c_j=F x_j-x_(j+1) and reduce modulo im(F-I) on K (or the Tate-twisted cyclic coboundary)

outcomes.nonzero_class: no C4-coherent pair lift exists for that Evans packet
outcomes.zero_class: constructs a coherent lift but does not yet prove completion or positivity
outcomes.empty_fiber: the Evans class is not in the joint pair image at all

relation_to_RH: Vanishing of this algebraic cocycle is a source-comparison theorem, not yet RH, provided it is proved before evaluating the positive modular defect. Confinement enters only after the descended one-leg energy and Xi-cycle boundary equality are established.
next: Extract finite q_+, q_-, and Fourier/Tate F matrices from the two-polarity packet and evaluate the affine-fiber cocycle for the source Evans endpoint/mismatch column.
conclusion: The proposed quotient order exposes a precise missing coherencer: not an equality of representatives, but trivialization of a C4 radical-valued torsor cocycle. This is the categorical datum that can be sought independently of the later positive modular argument.
